title: Daily Eval Briefing 2026-10-14: Self-Scaling Arenas, Perturbation Harnesses, and Judge-Layer Choices
subtitle: Same-day 2026-10-14 feed is thin; the 36-hour window is dominated by leakage-resistant coding arenas, reusable robustness transforms, and reward/judge design that treats labels as scarce.
summary: Publishable coverage for the official 2026-10-14 briefing is concentrated on 2026-10-13 releases within the freshness window rather than new same-calendar-day drops.
